description: Machine-readable sales six-step gate model. This is the authority for sales stage progression, gate checks, missing information, recommended activities, evidence, and UI/test routing.
authority_doc: docs/DEV-30-销售六步法Gate驱动运营设计.md

discover.label: Discover
discover.goal: Map customer power, pain, current state, competition, and next action before treating an opportunity as real pipeline.

gates.label: Champion or target champion identified
questions: Is there a champion or target champion?
Who interacted most, asked questions, commented, or listened carefully during the discussion?
recommended_activities: Collect meeting participants and behavior signals
Map candidate champion influence and department
Ask sales to distinguish coach from champion

gates.label: Customer concerns identified
questions: What concerns did the customer mention today?

gates.label: Champion department and organization context identified
questions: Which department is the champion in?
Was any organization structure or division of responsibility discussed?
recommended_activities: Collect organization chart or role map

gates.label: Decision makers, decision behavior, and EB hypothesis identified
questions: Who may be involved in decisions?
What decision actions are expected?
Who is likely the Economic Buyer?
recommended_activities: Ask champion candidate about decision process

gates.label: Pain and current state identified
questions: What pain points and current state may relate to our project opportunity?
recommended_activities: Collect current IT and business process

gates.label: Potential competitors or alternatives identified
questions: Were competitors, existing vendors, partners, or alternatives mentioned?

gates.label: Next action plan agreed
questions: Was a clear next action plan agreed, including time, participants, and objective?
recommended_activities: Ask sales to secure a concrete next meeting or action

scope.label: Scope
scope.goal: Turn vague demand into shared scope, benefits, timeline, possible budget, and champion commitment.

gates.label: Champion confirmed organizational benefit
questions: Did the champion personally or verbally confirm what benefit this project brings to the organization?
recommended_activities: Build preliminary business case with champion
Use Before/After, capabilities, metrics, solution, differentiation, proof points

gates.label: Champion confirmed timeline
questions: Did the champion personally or verbally confirm the project timeline?
recommended_activities: Document milestones and expected decision dates

gates.label: Champion confirmed possible budget
questions: Did the champion personally or verbally confirm a possible budget or budget range?
recommended_activities: Clarify budget source and payment expectations

gates.label: Benefit, timeline, and budget confirmed in writing
questions: Was the above confirmed in writing, such as whiteboard photo, WeChat, email, or meeting minutes?

gates.label: Champion helped schedule EB meeting
questions: Did the champion help schedule a meeting with the Economic Buyer?
recommended_activities: Ask sales leader to join EB meeting when useful

go_no_go.label: Go / No-Go
go_no_go.goal: Before spending validation resources, confirm from EB whether the opportunity deserves continued investment.

gates.label: EB confirmed pain, priority, and business outcome
questions: Did EB personally or verbally confirm pain, priority, and business benefit?
recommended_activities: Confirm pain, priority, and business outcome

gates.label: EB confirmed process, timeline, and budget
questions: Did EB personally or verbally confirm process, timeline, and budget?

gates.label: EB confirmed vendor evaluation criteria
questions: How will EB evaluate vendors?
What are the key evaluation standards?
recommended_activities: Clarify scoring, price weight, and differentiators

gates.label: Post-validation EB meeting scheduled
questions: Was the meeting after vendor evaluation or validation scheduled with EB?
recommended_activities: Schedule post-validation review before leaving EB meeting

validate_solution.label: Validate Solution
validate_solution.goal: Create and execute a controlled validation plan with champion, collect proof, and confirm business process.

gates.label: Validation plan and standards discussed with champion
questions: Was a validation plan and standard discussed face-to-face with champion?
Is the form POC, reference visit, company visit, demo, or industry report?

gates.label: Validation plan and standards confirmed in writing
questions: Were POC or validation plan and standards confirmed in writing with champion?

gates.label: Validation process clarified
questions: What is the validation process?
What do we do and what does the customer do?
recommended_activities: Clarify roles, data, environment, timeline, proof collection, and business process

business_case.label: Business Case
business_case.goal: Turn validation proof into business value report, confirm with champion and EB, connect procurement, and prepare negotiation.

gates.label: Validation report reviewed with champion
questions: Was the validation report reviewed face-to-face with champion?
recommended_activities: Co-develop and finalize report with champion

gates.label: Validation conclusion reported to EB and solution confirmed
questions: Was the validation conclusion reported face-to-face to EB and was the solution confirmed?

gates.label: Procurement contact established through champion or EB
questions: Were we introduced to procurement through champion or EB?
recommended_activities: Ask champion or EB to introduce procurement/legal contacts

gates.label: Internal negotiation plan created
questions: Did our sales team create a negotiation plan?
recommended_activities: Define floor, tradeable value, allies, resistance, negotiation flow, and timeline

negotiate_close.label: Negotiate Close
negotiate_close.goal: Complete quote, order checklist, SOW check with delivery, and CRM final state check.

gates.label: Quote completed
questions: Has the quote been completed?
Does pricing model match contract amount?
recommended_activities: Finalize pricing and payment terms with champion

gates.label: Order checklist completed
questions: Has the order checklist been completed?
recommended_activities: Check contacts, PO, payment, invoice, contract files, revenue recognition

gates.label: SOW checked and confirmed with delivery
questions: Has SOW been checked and confirmed with delivery?
recommended_activities: Review scope, exclusions, acceptance criteria, resources, and delivery risks with delivery lead

gates.label: CRM state final check completed
questions: What is the CRM opportunity URL?
Are stage, amount, expected close date, and attachments accurate?
recommended_activities: Ask sales for CRM opportunity link

p1_exit_gates: Sales stage progression is based on gate status, not only manual CRM stage value.
Every confirmed gate links at least one evidence item or a human waiver.
Every missing gate generates an Information Gap and recommended Activity.
Go/No-Go cannot progress to validation without EB confirmation or explicit waiver.
Negotiate Close cannot be marked closed-won without quote, order checklist, SOW confirmation, and CRM URL/state check.
